content.text: The annotated arrows represent potential point-wise movements of the screwwdriver (where a point on the screwdriver travels from the base of the arrow to the tip of the arrow). Following which two arrows would the screwdriver be moved into a pose that is most suitable for operating on the screw on the chair that is closest to the human hand? Choices:  A. Red and blue. B. Green and purple. C. Blue and green. D. Yellow and orange. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
